verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI specification, authentication and parameters (docs-39, docs-10). It also offers an `@lobehub/sdk` generated from that OpenAPI spec, covering methods, auth and streaming (docs-64), plus a CLI for operating an existing instance (docs-38). A probe confirmed a live openapi.json at lobehub.com (probe-3). missing for 10: evidence of how much of the product's functionality the API endpoints cover, independent or community hands-on reports of driving the product via the API.
